name: Hungary

outcome.intro: After studying this section, a student will be able to recognize Tokaji as a wine from Hungary and one of the great sweet wines of the world.
outcome.certified: After studying this section, a student will understand Tokaji's grape growing and winemaking. A Certified Sommelier will be able to sell and recommend food pairings with Tokaji to a guest.

rows.intro: Hungary is located east of Austria.

rows.certified: Bodrog River creates humidity in Tokaj.
Puttonyos: The name of the basket in which the aszú grapes were traditionally gathered.; Aszú: Shrivelled and botrytis-affected berries.
Eszencia: made entirely of Aszú berries.
Tokaji was not made during the communist years between World War II from 1949 to 1989.
Foie gras, blue cheese, orchard tarts
